Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
# 1x1 RGBA with interlace Adam7 and minimal data
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,1))
# compressed scanline for one pixel, interlaced may still decode
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
# trailing critical-ish? no, ancillary text after IEND won't be read. Put after IDAT before IEND.
text=chunk(b'tEXt', b'k\x00v')
poc=sig+ihdr+idat+text+iend
pathlib.Path('interlace_text.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
PY
